manifest.validation: Current snapshot compiled from exact tracked HEAD source; emitted runtime matches the workspace build. Baseline JS matches original 0.9.1 byte-for-byte. Current runtime already passed build and 507 tests; no runtime changes since.

synthetic.timing: Initialization, resource admission, crawl and disposal; fixture setup and output hashing excluded.
synthetic.transport: Got 13 in 0.9.1 and Got 16 in current; retries disabled for fixture requests; loopback server closes each connection.
synthetic.validation: Every observation checks output file count/content/hash, HTTP request count, errors, current terminal outcomes and absence of staged files.

mdn.timing: Initialization, resource creation, replay processing and disposal; fixture setup and output hashing excluded.
lifecycleDifferences: Current uses the legacy save-path hook adapter.
Current imports the direct single-thread entry.
mdn.validation: Every observation checks errors, output file count, complete output hash and absence of staged files.

scope.dependencies: Per-package symlinks in both snapshots. Shared packages resolve to common physical directories. Current direct runtime package JS/JSON content and versions match the workspace installation.
scope.measurements: All new observations. No pooling with older reports. No runtime changes or extra measurement rounds after examining results.
scope.memoryAndCpu: Raw process CPU and sampled RSS/event-loop data are diagnostic. RSS includes workers, uses 10 ms sampling and can miss short peaks. No aggregate memory or CPU speedup claim.

suites.method: Fresh process per variant per round, including MDN; one process median per case. Rotate/reverse order: each variant occupies each position four times. Tests and benchmarks run serially.
suites.noiseRule: Four-million-operation CPU probes bracket timed work. Five warm-ups and nine calibrations fix a 1.5x median threshold before each suite. Reject the whole three-variant round for a case if any measured probe exceeds the threshold. Require four qualifying rounds. No filtering by candidate outcome and no added rounds.
